paragraphs.en: This repository (" Code - OSS ") is where we (Microsoft) develop the Visual Studio Code product together with the community. Not only do we work on code and issues here, but we also publish our roadmap , monthly iteration plans , and our endgame plans . This source code is available to everyone under the standard MIT license .
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库（“Code - OSS”）是我们（Microsoft）与社区共同开发 Visual Studio Code 产品的地方。 我们不仅在这里处理代码和问题，还发布我们的路线图、每月迭代计划以及收尾计划。 本源代码依据标准 MIT 许可证向所有人开放。

paragraphs.en: Visual Studio Code is a distribution of the Code - OSS repository with Microsoft-specific customizations released under a traditional Microsoft product license .
paragraphs.zh: Visual Studio Code 是 Code - OSS 仓库的一个发行版，包含微软特定的定制，并根据传统的微软产品许可证发布。

paragraphs.en: Visual Studio Code combines the simplicity of a code editor with what developers need for their core edit-build-debug cycle. It provides comprehensive code editing, navigation, and understanding support along with lightweight debugging, a rich extensibility model, and lightweight integration with existing tools.
paragraphs.zh: Visual Studio Code 将代码编辑器的简洁性与开发者在核心的编辑-构建-调试周期中所需的功能结合在一起。 它提供全面的代码编辑、导航和理解支持，同时配备轻量级调试、丰富的扩展模型，以及与现有工具的轻量级集成。

paragraphs.en: Visual Studio Code is updated monthly with new features and bug fixes. You can download it for Windows, macOS, and Linux on the Visual Studio Code website . To get the latest releases every day, install the Insiders build .
paragraphs.zh: Visual Studio Code 每月更新，提供新功能和错误修复。 你可以在 Visual Studio Code 网站上下载适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的版本。 若要每天获取最新版本，请安装 Insiders 版本。

paragraphs.en: Many of the core components and extensions to VS Code live in their own repositories on GitHub. For example, the node debug adapter and the mono debug adapter repositories are separate from each other. For a complete list, please visit the Related Projects page on our wiki .
paragraphs.zh: VS Code 的许多核心组件和扩展都存放在 GitHub 上各自的仓库中。 例如，node 调试适配器和 mono 调试适配器的仓库就是彼此独立的。 完整列表请访问我们 wiki 上的 Related Projects（相关项目）页面。

paragraphs.en: VS Code includes a set of built-in extensions located in the extensions folder, including grammars and snippets for many languages. Extensions that provide rich language support (inline suggestions, Go to Definition) for a language have the suffix language-features . For example, the json extension provides coloring for JSON and the json-language-features extension provides rich language support for JSON .
paragraphs.zh: VS Code 在 extensions 文件夹中内置了一组扩展，包括许多语言的语法和代码片段。 为某种语言提供丰富语言支持（内联建议、转到定义）的扩展，其名称带有 language-features 后缀。 例如，json 扩展为 JSON 提供着色功能，而 json-language-features 扩展为 JSON 提供丰富的语言支持。

paragraphs.en: This repository includes a Visual Studio Code Dev Containers / GitHub Codespaces development container.
paragraphs.zh: 此仓库包含一个 Visual Studio Code Dev Containers / GitHub Codespaces 开发容器。

paragraphs.en: For Dev Containers , use the Dev Containers: Clone Repository in Container Volume... command, which creates a Docker volume for better disk I/O on macOS and Windows.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Dev Containers，请使用 Dev Containers: Clone Repository in Container Volume... 命令，该命令会创建一个 Docker 卷，以便在 macOS 和 Windows 上获得更好的磁盘 I/O 性能。

paragraphs.en: For Codespaces, install the GitHub Codespaces extension in VS Code, and use the Codespaces: Create New Codespace command.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Codespaces，请在 VS Code 中安装 GitHub Codespaces 扩展，并使用 Codespaces: Create New Codespace 命令。

paragraphs.en: Docker / the Codespace should have at least 4 cores and 6 GB of RAM (8 GB recommended) to run a full build. See the development container README for more information.
paragraphs.zh: Docker / Codespace 应至少具有 4 核和 6 GB 内存（建议 8 GB），才能运行完整构建。 更多信息请参阅开发容器 README。
